blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skin cancer is a global health concern. Early detection of skin cancer lesions and treatment planning are important for reducing premature deaths. To deal with the dermatologists’ limitations, automated systems are highly demanding for examining skin conditions. Lesion segmentation is one of the prerequisites for developing any computerised system. The commonly used deep segmentation networks are trained in a centralized manner, i.e. images, and their annotated segmentation masks are gathered in a centralized server, and the training is performed. This centralized training loses data privacy, which is an important concern for the medical domain. Moreover, a huge computation has to be conducted on a single server. Hence, the feasibility of applying federated learning is experimented with and analysed for skin segmentation model development. The train and valid set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset is used to simulate the distributed learning environment and build a federated model. The test set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset and P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset are used for performance evaluation. As per experimental results, the federated model produces comparable performance with the centralized training and improves the local models.
blocks.zh: 皮肤癌是一个全球性的健康问题。 及早发现皮肤癌损伤和治疗规划对减少过早死亡至关重要。 为了应对皮肤科医生的局限性,自动化系统非常需要检查皮肤状况。 分解是开发任何计算机化系统的先决条件之一。 常用的深分网络采用集中式训练方式,即图像,其注释分口口罩被收集到集中式服务器上,进行训练. 这种集中化的培训失去了数据隐私,这是医学领域的一个重要关注. 此外,必须在单一服务器上进行大量计算。 因此,对应用联合学习的可行性进行了试验和分析,以便开发皮肤分解模型。 2018年国际标准行业分类皮肤损伤分解挑战数据集的列车和有效集用于模拟分布式学习环境并构建联想模型. 2018年国际标准行业分类皮肤损伤分解挑战数据集和PH 2 PHQXX2}数据集的测试集用于性能评价. 根据实验结果,联邦模式与集中式培训产生可比性能,并改进了当地模式.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Skin cancer is a major threat to our society. The early detection can reduce premature death. The development of an automated system is required to reduce the experts’ workload and enhance medicare for early detection of such skin conditions. Automated skin image segmentation algorithm development is an important pre-requisite for such automated systems [ 14 ] . Although several classical image processing techniques are proposed [ 1 ] , their performance is limited and prone to misclassification of the image pixels. In contrast, the application of the latest deep learning-based approaches will be a better choice as they have proven to be efficient in many image analysis applications [ 8 ] . Broadly, the segmentation network can be built with deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) based encoder-decoder-like architecture [ 13 ] or transformer-based architecture [ 3 ] . In deep networks of the first kind, the encoder obtains the low-dimensional feature representation of the input images, and the decoder finds the semantic maps of the pixels using the low-dimensional feature representation. On the other hand, transformer-based approaches find low-dimensional image representation with attention mechanisms, and by combining the feature representation with object queries, the object regions are obtained. Note that the DCNN-based architectures fail to capture the global context of an image during feature learning [ 16 ] , and the transformer networks are not capturing local interactions in the feature maps [ 15 ] . Hence, several segmentation architectures are designed that hybridize the potential of both CNN and transformer networks [ 4 ] and applied in skin lesion segmentation purposes [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 皮肤癌是对我们社会的重大威胁. 早期检测可以减少过早死亡. 需要开发一个自动化系统来减少专家的工作量,加强医疗,以便及早发现这种皮肤状况。 自动外观图像分解算法开发是这类自动化系统的重要先决条件[14]. 虽然提出了几种古典图像处理技术[1],但其性能有限并容易使图像像素错分类. 相反,采用最新的以学习为基础的深入方法将是一个更好的选择,因为这些方法在许多图像分析应用中已证明是有效的[8]。 广义上,分解网络可以以深演化神经网络(DCNN)为基点的编码器-解码器类似架构[13]或变压器为基点的架构[3]来构建. 在第一种深层网络中,编码器获得输入图像的低维特征表示,解码器利用低维特征表示法找到像素的语义图. 另一方面,以变压器为基础的方法发现有注意机制的低维图像表示,通过将特征表示与对象查询相结合,获得对象区域. 注意基于DCNN的架构在特性学习过程中未能捕捉到图像的全球背景[16],变压器网络在特性地图中也没有捕捉到局部的相互作用[15]. 因此,设计了几种分块结构,将CNN和变压器网络的潜力相混合[4]并应用于皮肤损伤分块目的[6,7].

blocks.en: The key source of high performance in the above-mentioned approaches lies in the use of a huge volume of data samples during training. Getting a good volume of curated and annotated dataset(s) from a single clinic or hospital is often challenging. The easiest solution is to use a single repository and gather data prepared by all collaborated sources. However, this may violate data privacy and clinical ethics. Hence, federated learning is used as an effective alternative to train a robust model in collaboration with multiple sources without violating data privacy. In spite of data privacy control, federated learning distributes the computation among the collaborated parties (sources) and makes the computation de-centralized [ 17 ] . In general setting, federated learning is performed with the help of a parameter server. First, the parameter server creates a deep model and initializes the weight matrices. Then the model is sent to the collaborated clients for weight update based on their locally available dataset. Then, the updated models are transferred to the server for aggregation, which produces a global collaborative model. This process continues until the model converges. The model aggregation is performed with the FedAvg algorithm, which uses a weighted average of the weight matrices [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 上述方法的高性能的主要来源是在培训期间使用大量数据样本。 从一个单一的诊所或医院获得大量整理和附加说明的数据集往往具有挑战性。 最简单的解决办法是使用单一的储存库并收集所有合作来源所编制的数据。 然而,这可能违反数据隐私和临床道德。 因此,联邦学习被用作一种有效的替代办法,在不侵犯数据隐私的情况下,与多个来源合作培训一个强有力的模型。 尽管数据隐私控制,联邦学习还是在合作方之间分配计算(来源)并使得计算下放[17]. 在一般设置中,联邦学习是在参数服务器的帮助下进行的. 首先,参数服务器创建了深层模型并初始化了重量矩阵. 然后,该模型被发送给协作客户,以便根据其本地可用的数据集进行重量更新. 然后,更新的模型被转移到服务器进行聚合,这产生了一个全球合作模型. 这一过程一直持续到模型汇合. 模型聚合使用FedAvg算法进行,该算法使用加权平均值的权重矩阵[9].

blocks.en: This paper develops a deep segmentation model with federated learning with FedAvg algorithm [ 9 ] in the cross-silo setting, systematically evaluating skin lesions’ performance and analyzing its performance trade-offs. Equal weights are given to the clients during model aggregation in the server. As we are interested in analysing the algorithmic effectiveness of the proposed approach, we create a synthetic environment to create the clients and the parameter server. ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge training dataset [ 5 ] is used for training the federated segmentation model. After training, the performance of the federated model is analysed with ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge test dataset and P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset [ 10 ] . Literature shows that some works are available to develop deep skin image classification models [ 2 ] with federated learning. However, as per our survey, limited work attempts to develop a federated segmentation model for skin lesion segmentation. In contrast to that, this work employs a federated learning algorithm for building a skin lesion segmentation model, analyzes the performance of commonly used deep segmentation networks and analyzes the performance of commonly used segmentation loss functions.
blocks.zh: 本文开发出一个深层分解模型,在跨筒仓设置中采用FedAvg算法[9]进行联合学习,系统评价皮肤损伤的性能并分析其性能权衡. 在服务器的模型聚合过程中,对客户端给予同等的权重. 由于我们有兴趣分析拟议方法的算法有效性,我们创造了一个合成环境来创建客户端和参数服务器. 国际标准工业分类2018年皮肤损伤分解挑战培训数据集 [5] 用于培训联邦分化模型. 培训后,结合国际标准行业分类2018年皮肤损伤分解挑战测试数据集和PH 2 PHQQX2}数据集分析联邦模型的性能[10]. 文学文献显示,有些作品可以开发出深层皮肤图像分级模型[2],并有联合学习. 然而,根据我们的调查,为建立皮肤损伤分化的联邦分化模型而做的努力有限。 与此相反,本作采用了构建皮肤损伤分解模型的联邦学习算法,分析常用深分解网络的性能并分析常用分解损失功能的性能.

blocks.en: The rest part of the paper is organized as follows: Section 2 discusses the proposed methodology; Section 3 presents the experimental setup; the experimental analysis is kept at Section 4 ; and finally, Section 5 concludes the paper.

blocks.en: The block diagram of our work is presented in Fig 1 . Fig 1 shows that there are five clients surrounded by green borders where local model training is happening. Note that in this paper, we are considering five clients; however, a finite number of clients can participate in the federated training process. The parameter server is shown in the middle part of this diagram and shown as a red-marked circle. At the beginning, a deep image segmentation network with initial weight matrices is sent to all clients. On receiving the model and its parameters, each client trains the model with their local annotated images. After E E number of local model updates, the updated models are sent to the server for aggregation. The server then aggregates the clients’ models to have a single model. This process is continued for T T rounds of communications. Note that we apply the federated average algorithm [ 9 ] for preparing the global model and consider equal weights for all clients. For the reader’s convenience, the training mechanism is given in the Algorithm 1 .

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Federated Learning Algorithm
blocks.zh: 算法 1 联邦学习算法

blocks.en: Regarding segmentation architecture, we experiment with two state-of-the-art deep image segmentation networks, namely UNet [ 13 ] and TransUNet [ 4 ] . In short, the UNet architecture contains a series of convolution layers and deconvolution layers. The role of convolutional layers is to find the lower-dimensional feature representation of the input images, and the deconvolutional layers are kept to obtain the segmentation masks in the original dimension. In UNet, there is neuronal interaction in the local regions only. In contrast, TransUNet uses Convolutional layers to find the lower-dimensional representation of the input image with local neuronal interaction. Then, the lower-dimensional representations are processed in the transformer layers. In the transformer layers, the final image embedding is prepared with global neuronal interactions. The learnt feature is then processed with deconvolutional layers. Both of the networks are trained with the above-mentioned federated learning algorithms and compared.
blocks.zh: 关于分块结构,我们试验两个最先进的深层图像分块网络,即UNet[13]和TransUNet[4]。 简言之,UNet架构包含一系列的演化层和去化层. 分层的作用是寻找输入图像的下维特征代表,分层保存以得到分层口罩的原维. 在UNet中,只有局部地区存在神经相互作用. 相形之下,TransUNet使用Convolution地层来寻找输入图像与局部神经相互作用的下维代表. 然后,在变压器层中处理下维表示. 在变压器层中,最终的图像嵌入由全球神经相互作用来制备. 然后用分解层处理所学到的特性。 这两个网络都接受了上述联邦学习算法的培训并进行了比较。

blocks.en: As per our workflow, the training or weight update happens only for the clients. We use a combination of the following state-of-the-art loss functions: (i) Binary Cross Entropy (BCE), (ii) Dice Loss, (iii) Focal Loss. Note that the lesional areas are much less than the normal skin regions in the input images; hence, the BCE loss can be biased towards detecting normal regions. This motivate us to incorporate Dice Loss and Focal Loss, which have some capability to deal with this bias. The mathematical definition of those loss functions are given below:
blocks.zh: 根据我们的工作流程,培训或重量更新只针对客户。 我们综合运用了以下最先进的损失功能: (一)二等相交叉Entropy(BCE), (二)Dice损失, (三)焦损失. 请注意,在输入图像中,损伤区域远低于正常皮肤区域;因此,BCE损失可能偏向于检测正常区域。 这促使我们纳入Dice Loss和Cocle Loss,它们具有一定的能力来应对这种偏见。 这些损失函数的数学定义如下:

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use the following two publicly available dermoscopic image datasets for our research: ISIC: The International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC) prepared multiple dermoscopy image datasets and made them publicly available as challenge datasets [ 5 ] . We use the ISIC 2018 skin image segmentation challenge dataset as it contains the maximum number of skin lesion segmentation ground-truths. The dataset is organised into three subsets: training ( 2,594 2,594 ), validation ( 100 100 ), and test ( 1,000 1,000 ). We use available lesion segmentation ground truth annotations for our research. Note that the images have varying appearances and contain diverse clinical conditions, such as melanoma, melanocytic nevus, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, vascular lesions, dermatofibroma, and benign keratosis.
blocks.zh: 我们使用以下两个公开的外观图像数据集进行研究: 国际标准行业分类:国际皮肤成像合作组织编写了多套皮肤成像数据集,并作为挑战数据集予以公开[5]. 我们使用国际标准行业分类2018年皮肤图像分解挑战数据集,因为它包含最大数量的皮肤分解地真相. 数据集分为三个子集:培训(2 594 2 594),验证(100 100)和测试(1 000.)。 我们用已有的损伤分解 地面真相说明来进行研究 请注意,这些图像的外观不同,含有多种临床条件,如黑色素瘤、黑色素nevus、玄武细胞癌、分泌细胞癌、血管损伤、脱菌和良性红细胞病等。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Simulation for FL Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 FL 设置的数据模拟

blocks.en: This study simulates the decentralized learning environment. We consider five clients so we need to have five disjoint datasets that will serve as local datasets. For that, we split the training set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset into five disjoint sets- four sets containing 519 519 images and the remaining one containing 518 518 images. We hypothesize that simulating datasets through random splitting introduces a certain degree of non-IID data distribution across clients, mirroring what is commonly observed in real-world distributed learning scenarios. The validation set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge is used to assess the performance of the local training updates as well as the global model updates after federated aggregation. Both the test set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge and the P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset are used for the performance evaluation of the trained model.
blocks.zh: 本研究模拟了分散的学习环境. 我们考虑5个客户,因此我们需要5个脱节数据集,作为本地数据集. 为此,我们把国际标准行业分类2018年皮肤损伤分解挑战数据集的培训集分成了5个不相干数据集 -- -- 4组包含519 519个图像,其余518个包含518个图像。 我们假设,通过随机分拆模拟数据集,引入了一定程度的非IID数据在客户端之间的分布,反映了现实世界分布式学习情景中通常观察到的情况. 2018年国际标准行业分类皮肤损伤分解挑战的验证套用于评估当地培训更新以及联邦汇总后全球模型更新的绩效。 2018年国际标准行业分类皮肤损伤分解挑战的测试集和PH 2 PH^{2}的数据集都被用于对训练有素模型的性能评价.

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation Details and Performance Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 执行细节和业绩计量

blocks.en: The PyTorch deep learning framework [ 12 ] is used for implementing the proposed algorithm. The following deep segmentation networks: UNet [ 13 ] and TransUNet [ 7 ] are considered for experimental evaluation. For federated learning, the local models update weights for K K interaction numbers before aggregating in the central server. The whole weight update is performed for T T rounds. The value of K K , T T is decided experimentally as presented in Section 4 . The models are trained with a stochastic gradient descent algorithm with an initial learning rate of 0.001 0.001 and momentum of 0.9 0.9 . An experiment is carried out to determine the right combination of losses in our ablation study presented in Section 4 . For comparison with the local models built with the local dataset and the centralized training having the whole dataset, an initial learning rate of 0.001 0.001 and momentum of 0.9 0.9 is used.
blocks.zh: PyTorch深层学习框架 [12] 用于实施所拟议的算法. 以下深度分解网络:UNet [13]和TransUNet [7] 考虑进行实验评价. 对于联邦学习,本地模型更新了K K 交互数字的权重后再在中央服务器中汇总. 整个重量更新是为T T 弹出. 如第4节所示,K K、T T 的数值是试验性决定的。 模型的训练采用有花样的梯度回落算法,初始学习率为0.0010.001,动力为0.90.9. 进行了一项试验,以确定第4节中介绍的我们的发展研究中损失的正确组合。 与利用当地数据集建立的地方模型和拥有整个数据集的集中培训相比,采用了0.001 0.001的初始学习率和0.9 0.9的势头。

blocks.en: In this work, the skin lesion segmentation models are evaluated with the following five commonly used metrics for performance analysis: Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), intersection-over-union (IoU) also known as Jaccard index or Jaccard similarity coefficient, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score [ 11 ] .

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussions
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: This section discusses the experimental results obtained from our research. We are interested in comparing the performances of the federated learnt model with the following two scenarios: (i) the local models with their own data and (ii) a single model prepared with centralized training having all images and their ground truths. The first competing approach will advocate the efficacy of the federally learnt model, and the second one can provide an idea of how much the performance is dropped when centralised training is impossible. The performance with respect to the test set of ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation is available at Table 1 and the performance with the images available in P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset is available in Table 2 . In the rest of this section, the models trained locally with its own dataset (as mentioned in Section 3.2 ) are denoted by ‘local-1’ , ‘local-2’ , ‘local-3’ , ‘local-4’ , and ‘local-5’ ; the model trained with federated learning is denoted as ‘global-FL’ ; finally, the models trained centrally with the full dataset is denoted by ‘global-L’ .

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that for both UNet and TransUNet, the local models (local-1 to local-5) trained with local datasets perform inferior to the centrally trained global model (global-L), which has access to all client’s images. This justifies that if a centralized model-building set-up exists, the centrally trained global model (global-L) would perform better than an individual client for the chosen dataset. The probable reason is that such a model would have access to more images, which generalized the input in a better way. The federated global model (global-FL) performs better than the best local model for both segmentation networks. This advocates that federated learning can capture the data diversity available to different clients without accessing the raw images. However, the performance of the federated global model (global-FL) is comparable to the centrally trained global model (global-L).
blocks.zh: 表1显示,在UNet和TransUNet中,经过当地数据集培训的当地模型(当地1至5个)的表现低于中央培训的全球模型(Global-L),后者可以访问所有客户的图像。 这就证明,如果存在一个集中的模型构建设置,经过中央培训的全球模型(Global-L)将比选定的数据集的单个客户更好地发挥作用。 可能的原因是,这种模型能够获取更多的图像,从而以更好的方式将输入普遍化。 联合全球模型(Global-FL)的表现优于两个分块网络的最佳本地模型. 这主张联合学习可以捕捉到不同客户可用的数据多样性而无需访问原始图像. 然而,联邦全球模型(Global-FL)的表现与中央培训的全球模型(Global-L)相当.

blocks.en: Our second experiment validated the performances of the trained models obtained from the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset with respect to P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset (an external dataset). This will highlight the relative performance gap of the models and justify the importance of the federated global model. Table 2 contains the performance observed in P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset. We find that the performances are degraded for all models trained with ISIC 2018 dataset. The probable reason is that the P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dataset was prepared early, and the imaging device was not that much improved; thus, they might have more imaging artefacts, so segmentation is relatively difficult than the ISIC dataset. However, the relative performance gap among the models is quite similar to our first experiment. The global-FL model is performing much better than the best local model. The global-L and global-FL models for both UNet and TransUNet achieve very similar performances in terms of all of the performance metrics. Moreover, in some cases, global-FL beats global-L (for example, dice score in the case of UNet). In both our first and second experiments, TransUnet outperformed UNet by a significant margin, as shown in Tables 1 and 2 . For example, the Dice score for TransUNet is ∼ 3 % \sim 3\% higher than the Dice for UNet (look at the rows for the global-L of TransUNet and the global-L of UNet in Table 2 ). These results clearly show that TransUNet is more effective in segmenting skin lesions. Due to this, the rest of our experiments are only conducted for TransUNet.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二次实验验证了从国际标准行业分类2018年皮肤损伤分解挑战数据集(PH 2 PH^{2}数据集(一个外部数据集))获得的训练有素模型的性能。 这将突出模型的相对性能差距并证明联合全球模型的重要性。 表2载有在PH 2 PH^{2}数据集中观察到的性能. 我们发现,所有经过国际标准行业分类2018年数据集培训的模型的性能都退化了。 可能的原因是PH 2 PHXXX2}的数据集是早期准备的,而成像设备的改进程度没有那么高;因此,它们可能有更多的成像工艺品,因此分解比国际标准行业分类数据集相对困难. 然而,模型之间的相对性能差距与我们的第一次实验相当相近. 全球FL模型的表现比最佳的本地模型要好得多. UNet和TransUNet的全球-L和全球-FL模型在所有业绩计量方面都取得了非常相近的业绩。 此外,在某些情况下,Global-FL优于Global-L(例如UNet的骰子得分). 如表1和表2所示,在我们第一次和第二次试验中,TransUnet的成绩大大超过UNet。 例如,Trans的二分分数 UNet比 UNet 的 Dice 高 3%\sim 3% (见表2中的 TransUNet 环球L 和 UNet 环球L 的行) 。 这些结果清楚地表明,TransUNet能更有效地分解皮肤损伤。 由于这个原因,我们剩下的实验只是为TransUNet进行的.

blocks.en: \justify Ablation Study. The ablation study is conducted to choose the right loss function for training the networks. In this study, we train only the model global-FL to decide the loss function by selecting an optimal combination of different loss components. The loss components are the conventional segmentation losses: Dice, Focal, and BCE. Thus, the global-FL is trained for each of the following (joint) losses: Dice, Focal, BCE, Dice + + Focal, Dice + + BCE, and Focal + + BCE. All the models are trained with the training set of the ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation dataset, followed by the testing with its test set. Considering the various performance metrics, the results of this experiment are presented in a bar plot in Fig. 3 . It can be seen that Dice + + Focal loss shows superior or similar performances compared to other losses. However, Dice + + Focal loss yields ∼ 1 % \sim 1\% higher accuracy than others. Due to this, the combination of Dice and Focal losses is chosen as the loss function in our implementation. \justify Selecting Number of Epochs ( E E ) in An Iteration of Federated Learning. We also experiment to determine an optimal number of epochs in an iteration of the federated learning to train the global model (global-FL) of TransUNet. The number of epochs per iteration is set to 1 (see epoch_1), 5 (epoch_5), and 10 (epoch_10), and evaluated the performances of the global-FL TransUNet model. The Dice, accuracy, and F1 scores are shown in Fig. 4 , where the model is trained and tested on the ISIC 2018 dataset. The best performance is seen when the number of epochs is set to one per iteration. Although setting one epoch per iteration is computationally expensive, we set this value in our implementation to obtain higher performances.

Dice,精度,和F1的分数以图4来显示,该模型在ISIC 2018数据集上经过了培训和测试. 最佳的性能表现为:将时代数设定为每个周期一次. 虽然每次设定一个时代在计算上是昂贵的,但我们在执行过程中设定这一值是为了获得更高的性能.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and future scope of Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作范围

blocks.en: This paper experimented with the federated learning algorithm for dermoscopic image segmentation. Two commonly known deep segmentation networks are trained with the federated learning algorithm in a simulated environment. ISIC 2018 skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset is used for training the model and testing. The performance is also analyzed with respect to the P ​ H 2 PH^{2} dermoscopic image dataset. We find that the TransUNet is more suitable than UNet for skin lesion segmentation. The experimental outcome advocates that the global model trained with federated learning improves the segmentation performance in data restriction scenarios. However, in most cases, we find some performance gaps when a model is trained in a data restriction scenario rather than having full data access for centralized training. The performance obtained from the centrally trained global model shows that there is a huge scope to improve the segmentation performance so that the global model obtained from the federated learning will perform human-like.
blocks.zh: 这篇论文用联邦的学习算法实验了外观图像分解. 两个通称的深层分解网络在模拟环境中与联邦学习算法相训练. 2018年ISIC皮肤损伤分解挑战数据集用于模型和测试培训. 还对P H 2 PH =% 2} 外观图像数据集的性能进行了分析。 我们发现,TransUNet比UNet更适合皮肤损伤分解. 实验结果主张,通过联邦学习培训的全球模型可以提高数据限制情景中的分解性能. 然而,在多数情况下,当一个模型在数据限制情景下得到培训,而不是为集中培训提供完全的数据访问时,我们发现存在一些性能差距。 从中央训练的全球模型中获得的性能表明,在改善分化性能方面有很大的空间,这样从联邦学习中获得的全球模型就能够像人一样进行.

blocks.en: The imaging artifact, the presence of hair in the skin, creates dermatological images that are noisy and can mislead the training. Producing a reliable, trained model with such noisy images will be the immediate future work of this research. Developing a better deep network and utilising visual foundation models for skin lesion segmentation is important for future work. Moreover, the development of a federated learning algorithm for segmenting skin lesion attributes like pigmented networks, globules, etc., is to be conducted next. In future work, we will evaluate model performance under more nuanced non-IID conditions by employing advanced data partitioning strategies, such as the Dirichlet distribution-based sampling protocol. Enhancing security during model aggregation with privacy-preserving techniques like Differential Privacy, Homomorphoic Encryption is another important future scope of work.
blocks.zh: 成像文物,皮肤有毛发的存在,产生出吵闹的皮肤相片,可以误导训练. 制作一个可靠、训练有素的图像模型,将是这项研究的近期工作。 建立更好的深层网络,利用视觉基础模型进行皮肤损伤分解,对于今后的工作十分重要。 此外,下一步还要开发一种联邦学习算法,用于分解皮肤损伤属性,如色素网络、光彩等。 在今后的工作中,我们将通过采用先进的数据分割策略,如以Drichlet分布为基础的采样协议,在更细化的非IID条件下评价模型性能. 在模型集成期间加强安全,采用不同隐私,同形加密等保护隐私的技术,是未来另一个重要的工作范围.
